description: Mechanical cross-check of contraction_saturation.md Part VI: the same-branch (3-formula) and cross-branch (4-formula) theta-bridge arithmetic, and the internal-vertex-count growth used in the S5 cut-vertex saturation argument.
scope_note: Tests only the symbolic arithmetic of VI.3/VI.4 by explicit gadget construction, and the internal-vertex-count formula used in VI.2's S5 citation. Does NOT test and does not claim to resolve VI.5's saturation target, which contraction_saturation.md leaves explicitly open, nor Part VII's Type T multi-vertex interaction, nor Part V's crossing case. This run caught and led to correcting a real hand-derivation error in the original VI.4 write-up (options 3 and 4 had d0/d1 swapped); the corrected formulas in contraction_saturation.md match this verified code. Kept separate from the five prior contraction verifiers, none of which are touched.
note_on_python_version: Same environment note as prior manifests: requirements.txt/.python-version pin CPython 3.14.6, unavailable in this container; this run used 3.13.12 with networkx==3.6.1 (matches requirements.txt's pin exactly).

results.cut_vertex_bound_internal_vertex_counts: computed for r,s in {2,3,4,5}x{2,3,4,5}, all >1, ranging 6..62 (see contraction_saturation.md VI.2 and the script's check_cut_vertex_bound for the full table)

detector_agreement: Every constructed gadget cycle validated by two independent implementations (hand-rolled adjacency traversal verify_cycle, and independently constructed networkx traversal verify_cycle_nx, both imported from verifier/contraction_lift.py); 0 disagreements after the direction-bug fixes caught during development.
completed_range: All gadget parameter tuples and the full 4x4 (r,s) grid processed to completion; this is a small, deterministic set of explicit illustrative constructions, not a search or census -- consistent with contraction_saturation.md Part IX's explicit decision not to launch broad computation this pass.
